findings.element: Spec M06 natural entry and IA summary
findings.rule: Current source consumers must agree with explicit §13.9 decision
findings.recommendation: Replace stale first-level skill-navigation wording with assistant-card management entry

reviews.source_location: Spec §13.9; Design Skill 结构组件; workbench-review.css final navigation/header rules
reviews.rationale: A second category navigation row conflicts with the explicit requested single top tab row. Retaining real opened-app tabs is required.
reviews.observed: All 1083 cases contain no .r14-primary-nav or .polo-resource-nav DOM. Assistant open actions show the preserved Polo 助手 top tab.

reviews.source_location: Spec §13.9 bullets 2–3, D-PC-13, corrected M06 table
reviews.rationale: Skill management must be directly accessible from the assistant card in each current space; circles remain ordinary personal homepage content.
reviews.observed: 34 card-bearing scenes per viewport contain both real controls; actual personal and enterprise clicks reach their skill manager; personal circle roundtrip works, enterprise has no personal circle home entry.

reviews.rationale: The divider reports page content moving beneath the fixed header, while nested lists and chat own their own boundaries.
reviews.observed: 921 initial header observations transparent. Real main scroll updates the fine line and returning to top removes it; skill-detail scroll at every viewport and both scopes does not activate host divider.

observations.detail: Scoped entries/header implement §13.9. No product-side review controls were introduced in these affected areas. Counts and shared component coverage are preserved; do not interpret this scoped judgment as complete unrelated product review.

limits: Not full product Acceptance or 100% visual fidelity
